name: 3236-sharegpt-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM dense decoder: 32 layers, 32 query and 32 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, context window 2048, float16. 6.7B parameters, ~13.5 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 20%, bounded at 2000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. streams is this engine's own `max-num-seqs`, so the two move together or not at all.
workload: `configs/data/sharegpt-2000-llama7b.jsonl`, 2000 real ShareGPT_V3 conversations, single turn each: the first human turn is the prompt and the length of the first assistant turn is the output length. `configs/data/make-dataset.py` redraws the file deterministically from the ShareGPT_V3 JSON; over the shipped rows it is 479893 prompt + 487783 output tokens. Sampling is part of the declaration: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k -1, n=1, no beam search, no presence or frequency penalty, no logprobs, and `ignore_eos` so every request emits exactly the row's output length. `request_format: plain` is REQUIRED, not preferred: this base Llama-1 checkpoint carries a spurious Llama-2 `[INST]` chat template, and applying it would change every prompt's token count.
purpose: A 7B chat assistant handling two thousand real conversational turns at 256 concurrent streams on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.3.3-109-g426ec4ec6711b, a source checkout from 2024-03. Two hazards:
#   * flat `key: value` lines only -- an indented or re-flowed line is not read.
#   * an argument this version does not define is a TypeError at construction, not a warning.
# Every value below is this engine's own default, written out so a default cannot drift.
model: huggyllama/llama-7b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
enforce-eager: false
seed: 0
